description: For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over F and each Options value [omitted, 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 3, 12, 48, 260] (1 dbDenyWrite, 2 dbDenyRead, 4 dbReadOnly, 8 dbAppendOnly, 16 dbInconsistent, 32 dbConsistent, 64 dbSQLPassThrough, 128 dbFailOnError, 256 dbForwardOnly, 512 dbSeeChanges, 1024 dbRunAsync, 2048 dbExecDirect): OpenRecordset (F, type, options); read Type, Updatable, Bookmarkable, EOF and RecordCount; close. Asks which flags each type accepts, the resulting Type and Updatable, and the refusals. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
